title: Agent Casino
tagline: Users give life (and funds!) to agents and allow them to play casino style games without user input.
description:
Our vision is to build out a agent casino powered by onchain contracts.

Our multi-agent service will allow users to deploy agents on-chain with one click and have them start playing casino games. Users can set the risk profile of their agents, fund the wallet

We envision a future were users can deploy agents to our casino and allow them to play 24/7.

Workflow:
1. User creates Agent (uses Basename). The can define the agents biography (mentioning risk, degen, etc if they want)
2. A coinbase wallet is created for the agent
3. User then deposits funds to agent's wallet
4. Every 5 minutes the agent is makes a decision (bull vs bear vs skip). We use eOracle for pricing feed.
how_its_made:
- CrewAI as a multi-agent framework
- Agent Factory contract to deploy + manage the agents
- Prediction contract for our first game using eOracle (an EigenLayer AVS) demonstrating a oracle use case
- Deployed on Base (1+n transactions every 5 minutes)
- Uses Coinbase AgentKit, CDP, and Coinbase MPC wallets (1 wallet per agent)
